I looked into faulty estimation of burned calories last time I was cutting calories. Part of it comes from an imperfect read on heart rate, but as far as fitness apps go, they make it worse by giving you estimates of total calories burned during increased physical activity, rather than a net excess. So if you count the calories towards your target for the day, you're counting your BMR twice during the time you exercised. The commonly suggested solution was to use about 75% of what a given machine or app told you was being burned, which worked pretty well for me.
